title: Leo and the Missing Shiny Shell
moral: Seek the truth calmly and be kind when solving problems.

scenes.summary: Leo joins Captain Mia and Diver Ben to help find a missing shell.
scenes.text: Leo was a little boy who loved the sea. One day he stood on a boat with Captain Mia and Diver Ben. A fisherman said his shiny shell was taken and blamed Ben. Leo held Ben’s hand and said they would find it together.
scenes.image_prompt: child on boat with captain and diver talking about missing shell colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: They search underwater but find the wrong shiny object.
scenes.text: They dived into the bright sea and followed a sandy path to a coral garden. A crab appeared holding something shiny, but it was only a bottle cap. The real shell was still missing.
scenes.image_prompt: underwater scene with crab holding bottle cap and people searching cartoon

scenes.summary: They follow clues with the help of a turtle.
scenes.text: Diver Ben noticed tracks in the sand. A turtle said it saw a crab carrying something. They followed the turtle through seaweed and a rock arch to search further.
scenes.image_prompt: turtle leading group underwater through seaweed and rock arch cartoon

scenes.summary: They find the shell and kindly get it back from a crab.
scenes.text: They found a crab in a cozy nook with treasures including the shiny shell. Leo spoke gently and offered a pebble. The crab gave the shell back without fear.
scenes.image_prompt: child gently trading pebble with crab for shell underwater cartoon

scenes.summary: The truth is revealed and everyone feels happy.
scenes.text: They returned to the boat and gave the shell to the fisherman. He apologized to Ben. Leo felt proud because they solved the problem together calmly and kindly.
scenes.image_prompt: happy group on boat returning shell and smiling cartoon

story: Leo loved the sea and went on a boat with Captain Mia and Diver Ben. A fisherman said his shiny shell was stolen and blamed Ben. Leo believed they could find it. They went underwater and searched a coral garden. They first found a bottle cap but not the shell. Ben saw tracks and a turtle helped guide them. They followed the path and found a crab with treasures including the shell. Leo spoke kindly and offered a pebble, and the crab gave it back. They returned the shell to the fisherman who apologized to Ben. Leo felt proud because they worked together and found the truth.
